narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

Bug was in `orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41). It taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, so any case with both a discount and a tax came out too high.

Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`. No other issues found.
